name: scheduleDeviceFarmRun
description: Schedules a mobile test run on AWS Device Farm run_api mode. appArn/testPackageArn/devicePoolArn are preferred from client input, but the server will fallback to per-project cached ARNs when omitted (cache TTL: 24h). Returns run metadata including runArn.

runName.description: Optional human-readable run name. Auto-generated when omitted.

projectArn.description: Optional Device Farm project ARN override. Defaults to config devicefarm.project_arn when omitted.

appArn.description: Optional app upload ARN. When omitted, server tries cached app ARN for the project.

devicePoolArn.description: Optional device pool ARN. Server tries cached pool ARN first; if still empty it falls back to first available pool in the project.

testType.description: Optional Device Farm test type. Defaults to APPIUM_NODE.

testPackageArn.description: Optional test package upload ARN. When omitted, server tries cached test package ARN for the project.

testSpecArn.description: Optional ARN of a custom test spec.
